title: hosted-api-tiered-tenant-quarantine-and-transparent-fallback-for-customer-escalations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: During the last two customer escalations we observed tenant-triggered 5xx waves caused by a combination of proxy connection churn, aggressive client retries, and transient KV cache thrashing. This ticket implements a multi-layered mitigation: a tenant quarantine state that limits fanout and rate for offending tenants, a transparent slowpath fallback to a conservative execution profile (smaller batches, fixed timeouts, and reduced concurrency), and an observability surface + runbook for SRE/SEs to rapidly contain and remediate escalations. Goals: 1) reduce blast radius and customer-visible 5xx/timeouts within 60s of detection, 2) provide safe automated fallback to preserve throughput for healthy tenants, 3) provide clear rollout and rollback gates for on-call and account teams. Scope: edge proxy admission + per-tenant token bucket, runtime execution profile variants (normal, slowpath), SDK guidance for idempotency token enforcement, and dashboards/alerts for quarantine triggers and rollback metrics.
comments: 2025-11-02 - Aisha Patel: Filed after postmortem meeting with SE and SRE. Priority assigned P0 due to active escalations from two customers (ACME & FinWave). Initial proposed approach: two-tier quarantine + slowpath fallback. Linking PM and Design for UX/communication.

2025-11-03 - Marco Li: Completed spike to validate proxy-level admission control. Found that connection pool exhaustion occurs when concurrent tenant streams > 1500 for an instance; suggested soft quota of 500 per-proxy-host as initial throttle. Prototype PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/198.

2025-11-05 - Engineering leads (sylvia.ng, josh.hsu) review: asked for stronger idempotency guarantees before automatic retries are suppressed. Action: require SDK to surface idempotency token header and server to accept dedupe-window param. Added dependency ENG-511213 for idempotency token standardization.

2025-11-06 - Marco Li: Runtime changes started. Implemented 'slowpath' execution profile which forces continuous-batching window to 8ms, disables speculative-hedging, and reduces in-flight KV allocations. Local benchmarks: token throughput drops ~18% but median P95 latency improves under tenant surge conditions. PR: runtime/pull/6241. Need perf review from infra team.

2025-11-07 - Observability: Added quarantine metrics to Grafana dashboard (quarantine_state_count, quarantine_trigger_reason, tenant_retries_suppressed). Alert rules drafted: 1) quarantine_count > 0 for > 30s AND 5xx-rate increase > 0.5% -> Pager. Link: grafana/tenant-quarantine-overview.

2025-11-08 - SRE runbook draft uploaded: confluence/tenant-quarantine-runbook. Runbook includes detection, graceful customer comms template, and steps to manually release tenant quarantine and revert runtime profile. Added to attachments.

2025-11-09 - QA: Integration test flake found when quarantine is toggled during inflight streaming sessions — clients saw duplicate partial streams. Root cause: streaming session state wasn't checkpointed on admission change. Mitigation: block toggle for sessions with active stream > 2s; longer-term fix in ENG-200321. Temporary guard added to proxy.

2025-11-10 - PM (Rhea Morgan): Coordinate customer communication plan. For affected customers, offer immediate opt-out from automatic quarantine and schedule dedicated postmortem. Drafted email template in confluence.

2025-11-11 - Marco Li: Canary rollout started to 3 edge pods in us-west-2 (canary-1, canary-2, canary-3). Observed one false-positive quarantine for internal test tenant due to bursty batching — threshold adjusted to require 2 consecutive 10s windows. No customer-visible 5xx reported so far.

2025-11-12 - Decision log: Keep automatic quarantine ON for tier-2+ tenants, require manual opt-in for tier-1 (SLA) customers. Plan to ship in runtime-1.32 with a 2-week monitoring window before broad rollout. Post-release tasks: follow-up on streaming session checkpointing and SDK idempotency telemetry. Assigned follow-ups: ENG-42199 for SDK guidance, ENG-200321 for session checkpointing fix.
